title: Knowledge
description: Runs a similarity search against the vector store — adjust topK and minScore to control how many results come back and how strict the match must be.
topKTitle: How many nearest results to fetch (passed to the server)
minScoreTitle: Results below this score are filtered out (client-side — the API does not accept minScore)
emptyDescription: Type a query to find matching passages. There's no catalog to browse — results come from a similarity search.
noResults: No results. Try a different query or lower minScore.
